authorization: After the Contents picture dots release (#585), the owner asked to fix its two declined follow-ups end to end ("Okay, let's do one and two, end to end.").

release.summary: Contents' dots (verseImages:getPaintedChapters and getPaintedBooks) count a candidate verse only when it is a verse Contents shows (the canonical id, within bible-structure's verse counts) and the wall's picture rule (spreadPictureOf: newest picture in the first style that has one, visible, file still there) finds a picture. A stray picture past a chapter's last verse or one whose file is gone no longer lights a dot. Convex only; the frontend is unchanged.
release.cause: Two follow-ups declined in #585: a legacy row past a chapter's end (e.g. Romans 14:24, where Contents stops at 23) and a row whose storage file was missing could mark a chapter and book whose wall showed nothing.
release.leftOut: Nothing else was waiting: production Convex was f62c377e (#585); main since then held only the record PR #586 (docs) and #587.

steps.convex: Pushed to production unique-impala-244 from a clean detached checkout of origin/main with no .env.local, in .claude/worktrees/release (dry run first; no index deleted).
steps.vercel: Not deployed: no frontend change. Production stays dpl_42kXK9k4zomCk6MoFzfcJdL5Emr3.

smoke.after: Production Convex via ConvexHttpClient on api.visibible.com with the four public styles: getPaintedBooks returned genesis, acts (0.4 s); getPaintedChapters returned Genesis 1, 2 and Acts 13, 14; Psalms none (0.4 s). visibible.com in headless Chromium at 390x664 showed the same chapter and book dots. Spending POSTs were blocked; nothing painted, no spend.
smoke.beforeRelease: New test (red before the fix with [14, 15, 16]) passes; npm test 159 files, 1753 tests; typecheck and eslint clean; npx convex dev --once --typecheck enable passed against an isolated local backend; GitHub quality-gates green on ed3a6073 (CodeRabbit hit its review limit). Two-axis code review and one sol-loop round with GPT-6.2 Sol on xhigh (APPROVE at ed3a6073; two nits declined as follow-ups in #587).

rollback.convex: Push Convex from f62c377e (or bcfa38b5) from a clean checkout; the frontend needs nothing.

productionWrites: One guest session from the browser smoke check; nothing painted or charged.
